note: Six repo_dependency edges from the family's one source repository (repo-ifa-repo-dependency-source) to six distinct target repositories, one per registry relationship type this Odu proves. Every one of the six repo_dependency writer templates (batchCanonicalRepoDependencyUpsertCypher and its five DISCOVERS_CONFIG_IN/DEPLOYS_FROM/PROVISIONS_DEPENDENCY_FOR/USES_MODULE/READS_CONFIG_FROM siblings in canonical_relationships.go) MERGEs on (source_repo:Repository{id})-[:TYPE]->(target_repo:Repository{id}) alone -- no property participates in the merge key (materializedEdgeIdentityByFamily["repo_dependency"] declares empty identity for every type), so this 3-tuple is each edge's full structural identity. RUNS_ON, the registry's seventh type, is deliberately absent: see materialized_edges_repo_dependency.go's package doc for why it is not fixture-reachable.
